From 7% to 56% in eight months.

Open-weight AI models handled just 7% of Vercel AI Gateway tokens in December. By August, that number hit 56%. AT&T now runs 40% of its AI workloads on open-weight models — cutting inference costs by 56%. Coinbase reports roughly 50% savings doing the same.

This is not a budget optimization story. This is a competitive leverage story.

When inference costs drop by half, the number of AI use cases that are economically viable doubles. Internal workflows that required executive sign-off at frontier pricing become deployable at scale. The organizations winning are not choosing between frontier and open-weight. They are routing intelligently — complex reasoning to frontier models, high-volume tasks to open-weight alternatives.

The margin is no longer in the model. It is in the routing logic.
